summaries.en: NSFW-Image-Detection-384 is a specialized computer vision model that automatically identifies inappropriate visual content, helping developers moderate user-generated images efficiently. It uses a compact 384x384 resolution architecture that balances accuracy with computational efficiency, making it suitable for real-time applications. Developers can integrate it via Hugging Face's pipeline API to filter uploads, monitor content streams, or build custom moderation tools with minimal setup overhead.
summaries.zh: NSFW-Image-Detection-384是一款专注于图像内容安全的开源模型，能自动检测图片中的不适宜内容，为开发者提供高效的视觉内容审核解决方案。该模型采用384x384分辨率设计，在保持较高识别精度的同时优化计算效率，适合部署在需要实时处理的场景中。通过Hugging Face的标准化接口，开发者可快速集成到上传审核、内容流监控等系统中，也可基于其预训练权重进一步微调以适应特定领域的审核需求。
